name: OAKA Residences

about: Two 30-storey towers of 175 units each on 2.2 acres of freehold land in Bukit Jalil, facing the Bukit Jalil Golf & Country Resort. With 350 units at 7 per floor, every layout has a storage room and 2 to 3 car parks, and units are handed over partially furnished. GreenRE Gold certified and pet-friendly, with an infinity pool, a 3,084 sq ft gym and a sky garden.
highlights: Freehold, 350 units at only 7 per floor
2 to 3 car parks for every unit
Handed over partially furnished
Infinity pool, 3,084 sq ft gym and rooftop sky garden
GreenRE Gold certified and pet-friendly
Foreigners can buy units priced above RM 1M

review.verdict: A freehold, low-density family condo facing the Bukit Jalil golf course, with generous parking and partial furnishing.
good: Freehold, with only 7 units per floor across 2 towers
2 to 3 car parks for every unit, and every layout has a storage room
Handed over partially furnished
Walking distance to IMU and Columbia Asia Hospital, about 1 km away

Maintenance fee of about RM 0.51 per sq ft, higher than most projects here
No LRT within walking distance; Sri Petaling and Awan Besar need a short drive

name: The Vividz
address: Jalan Bukit Jalil Indah 2, Bukit Jalil, 57000 Kuala Lumpur

about: Two 57-storey towers on 2.55 acres in Bukit Jalil, with 1,138 homes in all (569 per tower) and 7 retail lots. Layouts run from a 484 sq ft one-bedroom to 915 sq ft three-bedroom units, each tower has 5+1 lifts serving about 13 units per floor, and buyers choose between a bare unit or a partly furnished package. Facilities sit on Level 8 and on the Level 57 rooftop.
highlights: 1,138 units in two 57-storey towers on 2.55 acres
1-, 2- and 3-bedroom layouts from 484 to 915 sq ft
Maintenance fee about RM 0.44 per sq ft, including sinking fund

Level 8 facilities: Vividz Pool, Topaz kids' pool and jacuzzi, Body Builder Studio, Golden Years Gym, Chromatic Funland playground, Butterscotch Garden, amphitheater, multipurpose hall with pickleball and badminton court
Level 57 rooftop: Grill Garden, Herbs Garden, Serene Pavilion and Cloud Lounge
Bare unit or partly furnished: the partly furnished package has kitchen cabinets, hood and hob, fridge, microwave, washer and dryer, 2 air-conditioners, master bedroom wardrobe and water heater
Car parks: 1 for Type A, 1 tandem for Type B, 2 for Type C
Multi-tier security
Proposed shuttle bus to LRT Awan Besar, Pavilion Bukit Jalil and Jalil Link bus stop

review.verdict: The cheapest way into Bukit Jalil on this site, with big facility decks and compact layouts built for small households and rental.
good: SPA price from under RM 450k, the lowest quantum here
Maintenance fee of about RM 0.44 per sq ft is low for a project with this many facilities
Two facility floors, including a Level 57 rooftop with Grill Garden and Cloud Lounge
Compact one- and two-room units are easy to rent to singles and couples
Proposed shuttle bus to LRT Awan Besar and Pavilion Bukit Jalil

1,138 units at about 13 units per floor, so lifts and facilities are shared by many residents
Completion is 52 months after the developer's licence, so a long wait
Type B gets a single tandem car park
review.suits: First-time buyers and investors who want a low entry price in Bukit Jalil.
review.notFor: Families who need large rooms or two separate car parks below the 915 sq ft type.

2-room and 3-room layouts, both with 2 bathrooms

Mont' Kiara and Garden International Schools
